description: This file defines the Address class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing methods for constructing and formatting cell addresses in Excel, supporting both A1 and R1C1 reference styles.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Provides static methods for creating and formatting cell addresses in different reference styles, supporting array arguments for batch operations.

methods.name: cell
methods.description: Creates a cell address as text given the row and column numbers, with options for reference style and sheet name. Supports array inputs for batch processing.

methods.name: sheetName
methods.description: Formats the sheet name, adding quotes if it contains spaces or brackets, and appends an exclamation mark.

methods.name: formatAsA1
methods.description: Formats the cell address in the A1 style, considering relative or absolute references for row and column.

methods.name: formatAsR1C1
methods.description: Formats the cell address in the R1C1 style, considering relative or absolute references for row and column.
